title: San Jose builds homelessness data dashboard to track city shelter performance
summary: The new tool will track shelter use, length of stay, demographics, people housed, program exits and destinations, exits without notice and participant deaths.

title: States want ‘digital front doors,” but funding and AI-powered fraud are interfering
summary: Though building a “digital front door" has been a priority for state governments, several are facing challenges to consolidating identity management across agencies.

title: Aspen Institute pilots real-time EBT fraud blocking with states
summary: The tool is designed to flag potentially fraudulent purchases and temporarily block transactions, similar to fraud detection systems used by banks and credit card companies.

title: All states and territories secure approvals from NTIA on BEAD final proposals
summary: Illinois became the final state or territory to receive approval from the NTIA for its BEAD final proposal.

title: California launches statewide helpline for same-day opioid treatment
summary: State officials said that CA Bridge Connect is intended to close the gap between traditionally fragmented systems that can often make it difficult for people to find treatment when they are ready to seek it.

title: Delaware hires former federal agency CIO as state’s new chief technology officer
summary: After serving the U.S. Development Finance Corporation, Tina Donbeck has been named as Delaware's chief technology officer.

title: Texas names new internal CIO to lead AI efforts for state’s tech agency
summary: Amy Kelley will serve Texas in a new role, the internal CIO, and lead AI efforts for the state's Department of Information Resources.

title: New York police agencies are searching Flock data to aid immigration enforcement
summary: Police around New York state have searched Flock’s license plate database on behalf of ICE, according to new research by civil rights groups.

title: Pennsylvania launches voter data dashboard
summary: Secretary of the Commonwealth Al Schmidt said a new tool intends to give Pennsylvanians a clearer picture of how voter rolls are changing.

title: Delaware paired students with agencies in 3-day AI hackathon
summary: Delaware's state government led its first hackathon pitting university and high school students against real problems faced by the state.
